title: Haathkadi
desc: ACP Suraj, an honest policeman, swears revenge on culprits when his innocent brother is killed. However, he is soon accused of murder and is remanded to prison.

title: Jaal: The Trap
desc: Ajay, a commando, is forced to kidnap Anita, the home minister's daughter, to free his girlfriend Neha from the clutches of terrorists. In the process, he uncovers a shocking revelation.

title: Jung
desc: Desperate to save his son's life, Veer, an honest cop, is faced with an impossible choice when he discovers that the only person who can help him is a notorious criminal behind bars.

title: Raja Ki Aayegi Baraat
desc: A woman's desperate plea for justice falls on deaf ears as she's forced against her will to marry the man who assaulted her.

title: Narsimha
desc: Narasimha, an assassin, works for Bapji, a powerful thug, and kills people on his behalf. However, things take a turn when he is ordered to murder Ravi, and he declines to follow the order.
